I implemented all six functions in `minidb/expr_eval.py`, and `tests/test_expr_eval.py` passes (25 tests). I didn't change the test file or run the rest of the suite.

I added one private helper, `_check_bool`. `logical_not`, `logical_and`, `logical_or` and `where_matches` all use it to raise `TypeMismatchError` for any operand that isn't a bool or NULL.

I also made `compare` raise `TypeMismatchError` for an operator outside the six in `COMPARISON_OPS`. Likewise `evaluate` raises it for an unrecognised expression node. The stub docstrings don't specify either case, so those two errors are my choice.
